label: Stud Hidden Placket (2 Buttons)

profile.distinguishingDetail: The Stud Hidden placket is a hidden/covered placket designed specifically to accommodate formal shirt studs in place of buttons — the placket conceals the stud holes beneath its flap for a perfectly smooth, uninterrupted white shirtfront. A variation found on bespoke dinner shirts and some dress shirts, it combines the clean line of the hidden placket with the mechanical drama of gold or mother-of-pearl studs peeking through small openings. This is the standard construction for white tie and black tie formal shirts.
